mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 3% YoY, combined with a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.2M, signals a supply-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with both conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high RSAFS (above $350B) signals strong consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of months with RSAFS above $350B.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% YoY, combined with FEDFUNDS above 1%, signals a monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with both conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold-triggered signal: PAYEMS growth above 200K YoY signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances with PAYEMS growth above 200K YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in HOUST above 1.1M signals a demand-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of post-shock recovery months with HOUST above 1.1M.
